name: Job Closeout Packet Builder

product.customer: HVAC and plumbing shops using Jobber
product.description: Turn a completed Jobber job into a locally generated customer closeout packet in Markdown and PDF.
product.price_hypothesis: $49 for a paid pilot covering up to 10 reviewed packets; test willingness to pay before choosing ongoing pricing.
product.source_policy: Read-only official Jobber API or user-supplied export; fixture mode stays offline. No portal filing, message sending, or third-party uploads.

your_steps.title: Send the pilot pitch to one shop
your_steps.when: When you are ready to test buyer interest
your_steps.detail: Choose one prospect from prospects.csv, personalize the email in PILOT.md, and send it yourself. Nothing is sent automatically.
your_steps.instructions: Use the business contact information published by the directory and honor any request not to contact again. The prospect list is a research starting point, not a claim that they use Jobber or need the product.

launch_gates: Buyer confirms the closeout packet matches shop workflow and source records.
Customer authorizes read-only Jobber access or supplies an export before any real customer data is processed.
Owner and pilot shop agree to the $49 pilot scope and terms before charging.
